components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:58px; padding:0 18px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:#075FD8; color:#fff; font-size:17px; font-weight:600; } .ds-primary:active { opacity:.82; }

components.name: Outline button
components.css: .ds-outline { min-height:58px; padding:0 18px; border:1px solid #075FD8; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:#075FD8; font-size:17px; font-weight:600; } .ds-outline:active { opacity:.82; }

components.name: Status pill
components.description: A checked status, based on StatusPill.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-block; padding:5px 8px; border-radius:6px; background:#DDF8E5; color:#16833A; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; }

narrative.overview: Qeemat is an Android-first price tracker. The chosen direction is clean, practical, compact and calm: prices and useful status should be easy to scan. Retain the existing blue and light palette and Android system typography. Cards and controls should be mostly flat with subtle borders.
